what_it_is.prose: Europrop International (EPI) is a European four-partner engine consortium — Safran Aircraft Engines, Rolls-Royce, MTU Aero Engines and Spain's ITP Aero — that develops and produces the TP400-D6 turboprop, the most powerful Western single-rotation turboprop in production at roughly 11,000 shaft horsepower. The TP400-D6 has a single application: four of them power the Airbus A400M Atlas strategic/tactical airlifter. Because the A400M is not in Indian service — it has no Indian order and is widely reported to have fallen out of contention in the Indian Air Force's Medium Transport Aircraft (MTA) tender on size (~37-tonne payload) and cost grounds — Europrop International has no engines in Indian service, no Indian order and no Indian industrial partner. This dossier is deliberately a short Tier C stub documenting the absence of an India footprint rather than inferring one.
